base_branch.description: the pair's base branch, the public branch it works against: public_branch from the overlay config, main when the key is missing

public_main.description: the public base branch's tip (the name says main on every pair)

shadow_main.description: the shadow's base branch's tip; empty when the shadow repo has no such branch

shadow_behind.description: the shadow's base branch is a strict ancestor of public's; run sync

overlay_status.description: outdated when a managed overlay file needs ghostbranch upgrade

features.description: every feature, abandoned included, sorted by name
